deploy.note: Proposal only. Build OBC-Prime with these pins, then a human runs the command with the board on USB. This tool never flashes.

derived.bme280_address_rule: Bosch BME280 datasheet, section 6.2 I2C interface: CSB high selects I2C; SDO connected to GND gives address 0x76, SDO connected to VDDIO gives 0x77. SDO must not float.

reserved_gpios_source.citation: Espressif ESP32-S3-WROOM-1/1U Datasheet, section 'Strapping Pins' (GPIO0, GPIO3, GPIO45, GPIO46 sampled at reset to set boot mode, ROM log, VDD_SPI voltage and JTAG source). USB_D- / USB_D+ are GPIO19 / GPIO20 per the pin description table (module pads 13, 14). A design that drives a sensor bus on any of these pins is refused by OpenCircuitCore scripts/make_firmware.py.
